title: ADR-0034 step 3: runtime draft/publish UI chrome (flag-gated)
body:
Part of **ADR-0034** (`docs/adr/0034-unified-runtime-metadata-persistence.md`). Follows the merged seam work (#1513) and ObjectView wiring (#1514).

## Goal
When `VITE_RUNTIME_EDIT_VIA_META` is **on**, the runtime editors save a per-item **draft** (via `persistRuntimeMetadata(..., mode:'draft')`). They currently have no way to **publish** that draft or to surface that unpublished changes exist. Add the draft/publish chrome to the three runtime config panels, mirroring studio's `ResourceEditPage`.

## Scope
Add, **gated by `isViaMeta()` from `packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`** (so flag OFF = no UI change at all):
- **Publish** button → calls `publishRuntimeMetadata(type, name, { metadataClient })` (already exists in the seam).
- **"Unpublished changes"** indicator (read pending draft via `metadataClient.get(type, name, { state: 'draft' })`).
- **Discard draft** → `metadataClient.reset(type, name, { state: 'draft' })` (confirm the exact discard API in `data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`).
- On panel open, **resume** an existing draft (`get(..., { state:'draft' })`) so a half-finished edit is restored.

## Files
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` + host `ObjectView.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportConfigPanel.tsx` + host `ReportView.tsx`
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardConfigPanel.tsx` + host `DashboardView.tsx`
- Reuse studio chrome/affordances from `views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` and the `engine.edit.*` i18n keys (`engine.edit.publish`, `engine.edit.draftPending`, `engine.edit.discardDraft`, …).

## Acceptance criteria
- **Flag OFF (default): zero UI change** — none of the new affordances render; existing Save behaviour is byte-identical.
- Flag ON: Save writes a draft (existing seam); Publish promotes it (visible to other users + a new version); the indicator reflects a pending draft; discard removes it; reopening resumes the draft.
- `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell` + `pnpm -w vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views` green; lint clean.

## Notes / risks
- The **flag-ON path cannot be e2e-verified without a backend** — verify in a real environment (see the verification issue). Keep everything behind `isViaMeta()`.
- Default to per-item Publish; the batch "publish app" already exists in studio (`/packages/:id/publish-drafts`).
